title: Questions 161-163 refer to the following press release.
passage_1:
Halcyon Voyages to Unveil New Production

Halcyon Voyages announced that it will introduce Tidewater as the flagship entertainment offering aboard its new ship, the Halcyon Meridian.

The line hired Saltmarsh Stage Company to create the show in time for the Meridian’s first sailing in October of this year. Saltmarsh Stage Company is known internationally for its award-winning aerial productions. Its shows draw large audiences at celebrated venues in cities such as Copenhagen.

As with other projects by Saltmarsh Stage Company, Tidewater will bring together acrobatics, live music, and striking visual effects. It is being created solely for Halcyon Voyages.

With Tidewater, Halcyon Voyages once again sets itself apart from its competitors and reinforces its reputation for outstanding service.
